Media Types hub organization vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Photos smart-album capability on device covers storefront language. PhotoKit classification and Connect actually separate in-app library behavior from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Media Types — the system section (媒体类型) listing smart albums grouped by capture format on the buyer's device. Controls on-device navigation — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Format-specific smart albums under the hub — Videos, Selfies, Live Photos, Portrait, Panoramas, Time-Lapse, Slo-mo, Bursts, Screenshots, Screen Recordings, Animated, RAW, Cinematic, and related rows. Listing copy may name the hub grid; building album queries is engineering work.
  • Browse by media type — buyers open Media Types to jump into a format album instead of scrolling Recents. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building hub UI is engineering.
  • Hub vs child album framing — a screenshot showing the Media Types section header plus multiple format rows needs 媒体类型 hub vocabulary. A screenshot drilling into one Videos grid needs 视频相簿 copy on that frame — not the same hero as this hub page unless your English listing centers only Videos.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Media Types support in the binary.

Working Media Types hub navigation and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Media Types, 媒体类型, and format-album hub value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you wire smart albums in code.

FAQ

Does smart-album organization auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Media Types hub organization and format-album navigation control runtime library behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Media Types, Photos → Albums → Media Types, browse by media type, format album hub rows, 媒体类型, 媒体种类, and visible child-album labels — rewritten from your English originals.

Does AppLocale implement PhotoKit smart albums in code?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. PhotoKit smart-album queries, format classification, and Media Types hub UI engineering are outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from Videos, Selfies, Screenshots, and Recents pages?

Media Types listing copy covers Photos → Albums → Media Types — the hub section listing format smart albums on gallery frames. Videos-only, Selfies-only, and Screenshots-only pages center one child album. Recents and All Photos are general library surfaces — contrast only. Live Photos listing copy covers capture-mode marketing. Imports listing copy covers camera-import flows. Places listing copy covers location albums. Each surface has a separate guide.

Why do my Media Types screenshot captions still say Media Types in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 媒体类型 or 媒体种类 hub value.

Should zh-Hans copy use 媒体类型 or 视频相簿?

媒体类型 and 媒体种类 fit the Media Types hub section and multi-row grid frames. 视频相簿, 自拍相簿, and 截屏相簿 fit individual child-album drill-down frames — related surfaces but not the primary Media Types hub hero unless your English listing centers only one child album. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English claims and screenshot frames.
